inspectedText: Field-constrained neutron-transport models investigate uranium content, water-bearing porosity, geometry and neutron absorbers. Higher ancient fissile fraction and concentrated ore enabled criticality. Geological processes mobilized and deposited uranium. Remaining geometry is an end state; inception scenarios are reconstructions, not unique measured ancient conditions.
